title: Venue layout / blueprint (v2)
description: The blueprint shape the placement-editor authors and the engine serves (GET/PUT /blueprint), consumed by the engine, synthetic-adapter, wifi-adapter and the demo. Pinned in schema/VERSION. FRAME CONVENTION (the single source of truth, do not reinterpret per consumer): room-local + anchors + walls + calibration samples are in CANVAS-Y - origin top-left, x right, y DOWN. The floor-plan georef is LOWER-LEFT origin with z = NORTH-UP; `azimuth_deg` is the bearing of the floor-plan +z (image vertical) clockwise from true north. Conversion canvas-y -> georef-north-up happens once, at the engine `local` boundary: north_up = height_m - canvas_y. Adapters emit floor-plan-local north-up; the demo inverts the same way to render. Lenient (additionalProperties allowed) so additive editor fields don't break validation; the required keys below are the contract.

georef.description: Links the floor-plan-local frame to WGS84. Lower-left origin, z = north-up, azimuth_deg clockwise from true north.

height_m.description: Floor-plan metric height. The mirror axis for canvas-y <-> north-up.

room.description: Room rectangle placed on the floor plan, in canvas-y (top-left origin). x_m/y_m = top-left corner offset within the floor plan.

shape.description: Optional polygon [[x,y],...] in floor-plan canvas-y; overrides the rectangle.

anchor.description: Positioning anchor in ROOM-LOCAL canvas-y (origin top-left, y down). `technology` selects the adapter family.

wall.description: Wall segment in room-local canvas-y. openings are 1-D pass-through ranges along the segment.
